# Atlassian — Atlassian for Startups

Premium editions of Atlassian Cloud products at $0 for 12 months for up to 50 users, with Jira Product Discovery limited to 10 creator seats and unlimited contributors.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open - apply directly |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-14 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [📋 Productivity & Ops](../categories/productivity.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | free plan |
| **Amount** | The vendor publishes no figure |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Page states the offer covers one 12-month period. |
| **When it ends** | Before the end of your 12-month offer period, you will have the option to renew or cancel; paid upgrade options apply if user limits are exceeded. |


### Not covered

- Existing Atlassian paid customers
- Companies that have raised more than US$10 million in external funding

> **"Not stated by the vendor" means exactly that — not "no restriction".**
> This list never infers permission from silence, so anything the vendor did not
> put in writing stays unknown, and this entry is left out of the matching
> filters rather than guessed into them.

**Stages named by the vendor:** pre-seed, seed, series-a

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

All three criteria quoted verbatim: "Your company is not an existing Atlassian paid customer", "VC funded or associated with a partner accelerator and/or incubator", "Have not raised more than US$10 million in external funding". The prior hint of "partner-only" is only partly right: partner accelerator/incubator association is one of two accepted routes, VC funding being the other, so partner_gate is required-soft rather than required-hard. Because either route satisfies the gate, funding_required, requires_vc_backing and accelerator_required are each left unknown. The $10M figure is a CEILING (funding_max_usd). Covered products listed as Jira Premium, Confluence Premium, Loom Business + AI, Jira Service Management, Jira Product Discovery Premium and Bitbucket Premium, at up to 50 seats each (10 seats for Jira Service Management).
